title: Off-Board Fare Collection — Core Overview (Edition 1)
description: Collecting fares before boarding, at station gates or ticket machines, cuts vehicle dwell time dramatically. Curitiba's tube stations made prepayment a signature BRT feature in the 1980s. This overview edition presents Off-Board Fare Collection as a core transit concept for contemporary cities.

principles: Design for frequency, speed, and reliability
Integrate fares and transfers across modes

real_examples.fact: Curitiba's enclosed tube stations enabled level boarding and prepayment.

spec.source_note: Core facts verified from public sources.
